stories.headline: Western Union Bets on Stablecoins and M&A for Growth

stories.headline: Bankruptcy filings were up 11.9% in last 12 months
stories.body: Bankruptcy filings rose 11.9% during the past 12 months, according to statistics from the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts; JPMorganChase named Jerry Lee and Nick Richitt as global co-heads of health care investment banking; Goldman Sachs appointed Akila Raman as global head of its private and alternatives capital markets business; and more in this week's banking news roundup.
